property_summary: For any input _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract always sets MinSum equal to _val (i.e., MinSum becomes exactly the provided value), whereas the mutant subtracts _val from the existing MinSum, so there exist inputs where the stored MinSum differs and (for some inputs) the call may revert due to underflow — the test checks that after SetMinSum the getter returns the provided value.
change_summary: Change the assignment to subtract the provided value from MinSum (underflow protected by solidity >=0.8 will revert on underflow), altering the resulting MinSum.
